body.statement: For every stage \(r\ge r_0\), if \(\max_{m\in\mathcal E}\|S_{m,r}-\Sigma_m\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le a_r\le(2\kappa)^{-1}\), then every \(S_{m,r}\) is invertible as an \(n\times n\) matrix and \(\max_{m\in[n]}\|\widehat R_{m,r}-R_m\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le40\kappa^4a_r=e_r\). Consequently, simultaneously for every \(M\subseteq[n]\), \(\|\widehat R_r(M)-R(M)\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le |M|e_r\).
body.justification: This is the deterministic bridge from observable covariance confidence balls to every spectral decision used by the certificate.
body.gap: Acartürk et al. control estimated score correlations; the Gaussian specialization here must include covariance inversion and a fully empirical primitive matrix.
body.consumer: It provides the error budget used by interval ranks, projectors, and encoder bars in the official finite-sample implementation.
